long_biography.plain_text:
The Croatian Chamber of Economy elected Jere Gaćina to help represent maritime-tourism operators. He served as deputy leader of its tourist-shipping association and chaired the specialist group for professionally crewed charters. The roles placed him in discussions about operating standards, market conditions and common representation for passenger-cruise businesses.

Gaćina brought a technical background to that work. Trained in shipbuilding engineering, he gained experience in a shipyard and marine-equipment business before moving into charter operations, refitting and commissioning. He now serves on the management board of Gaćina Adriatic Charter and is registered in Šibenik as a court expert in maritime transport.
